ago\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Epatient was apparently alright 5 years back\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ein 2016- patient had jaundice,for which he used herbal medicine following which he had binge alcohol and severe loose stools,watery consistency (20 episodes\/day) - for which he was admitted in outside hospital ,patient reports that he was in altered sensorium for 3 days in ICU during that admission (no records available).3 pints PRBC transfusion in ICU was done at that time of hospital stay.since discharge patient was fine and in 2018 patient went for regular check up ,he says blood investigations were normal at that time\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3 days ago- patient c\/o giddiness and fall in washroom with injury on left side of forehead ,then he went to a local RMP and on routine investigation was found to have pancytopenia and was referred here ,no h\/o any ENT bleed , convulsions,LOC, blood loss during fall ,he complaints of generalised weakness since 1 month ,no c\/o SOB ,body pains,joint pains,fever, bleeding gums,malena,hematemesis,vomitings,loose stools,pain abdomen,cough, tingling,numbness of limbs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Epast history\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ealcoholic since 15 yrs,drinks daily ,180-240 ml ,attenders report that whenever he gets free time ,he keeps on drinking alcohol and when he stops drinking alcohol for one day ,he reports craving and withdrawal symptoms (trmens).attendants complained that he drank alcohol even today before coming to hospital\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDM(-),HTN(-)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Epersonal history\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eappetite- decreased since 5-6 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Edaily routine\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ewakes up at 8 am,goes to barber shop for about 1-2 hrs,goes to bar beside his barber shop ,comes home eats little food and sleeps.after waking up again goes to barber shop for 2 hrs ,drinks alcohol and comes back home ,eats dinner and sleeps\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eaddictions- chews gutka 5-6 packets
